messages:
Eli (docs): Noticed a discrepancy in the API ref for the embeddings endpoint: the OpenAPI example uses `include_embeddings: true` in the query/body, but the SDKs use `return_embeddings: true`. Customers are hitting 400s when copying snippets.

Rina (eng): Oof. Runtime accepts both keys currently (legacy alias) but swagger only documents the old one. We added `return_embeddings` when adding streaming/partial-embed support and forgot to update docs.

Marco (sdk): Confirmed: JS/Go clients expose `returnEmbeddings` option and set header `x-return-embeddings: 1` under the hood for some routes. I'll paste the canonical JS snippet we want to show in docs.

Tess (pm): Let's standardize on `return_embeddings` in docs (snake_case to match HTTP-level param) and add a migration note for customers using `include_embeddings`. Also update curl, python, and SDK snippets. ETA for a docs-only PR?

Eli (docs): I'll open a small PR. Marco, can you drop the curl and python examples quick? Also need a sentence for the param table describing the alias.

Marco (sdk): Curl: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"embed-1","input":"text","return_embeddings":true}'`

Marco (sdk): Python: `resp = requests.post(url, json={"model":"embed-1","input":"text","return_embeddings":True}, headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {TOKEN}"})`

Rina (eng): Suggested migration note text: "Note: `include_embeddings` is an older alias for `return_embeddings`. The server will accept `include_embeddings` for backward compatibility, but please migrate to `return_embeddings` by Q2 2025 for consistent behavior across SDKs and streaming endpoints."

Eli (docs): Great. I'll include that and update the parameter table, examples, and a short test case in the docs PR. Will tag @Marco and @Rina for review.

Tess (pm): Thanks — once merged add a changelog line and a one-sentence email to integrators who used the old key.

Eli (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/549 — small edits + migration note + updated examples. Tagging reviewers.
